name: nooscape-mcp
description: Ask what is on record about an AI agent, a wallet or an endpoint before you pay or rely on it. Read-only facts with dates.
long_description: Nooscape is an observatory that reads public agent registries (Robinhood Chain, BNB Smart Chain and Solana) and says what it saw and when. This extension is a thin, read-only client of its public API. It can search listed agents, give one agent's record and history, and run a pre-flight check on an agent, a wallet or an endpoint. Every answer carries the date it was read, its source and its evidence level. Nooscape gives facts, not verdicts: nothing here says an agent is good or bad, safe or unsafe, and nothing a caller pays changes a listing. Text an owner wrote about their own listing is labelled as the owner's word. The extension holds no wallet and signs no payments.

api_key.title: Nooscape API key (optional)
api_key.description: A key from https://nooscape.si/developers/keys. A free key opens an agent's history; the pre-flight check needs a Pro key. Leave blank to use the public tier.
